title: ISS market/series descriptor
description: Meta-schema for markets/*.json: every file in that directory both IS a JSON Schema (validating the shape of the ISS response it describes — a table with `columns`/`data`) AND carries `x-iss-*` extensions the AFB backend reads directly (iss_registry.py), the same technique afbws channels use with `x-afbws-support-id`. This schema validates only the `x-iss-*` extensions; the response-shape half of each descriptor is plain JSON Schema and needs no meta-validation beyond `$schema`/`$id` presence, checked here too.

path.description: ISS path relative to https://iss.moex.com/iss/, without the trailing .json — e.g. engines/futures/markets/forts/securities or statistics/engines/futures/markets/forts/series.

table.description: Top-level JSON key of the answer that carries {columns, data} — usually equal to the resource's own name (securities, series).

x-iss-instrument-type.description: listing.instrument_type this market's rows become. Absent for a series descriptor (a series is not a listing).

x-iss-series.description: Key of the markets/*.json series descriptor this securities market groups contracts through (e.g. 'futures_series' for futures). Only futures-shaped markets carry this.

api_name.description: MoexClient.resolve_market() alias for this market's live marketdata endpoint.

last_col.description: ISS marketdata column carrying the last traded price.

required.description: Absent from the ISS answer for this column -> the whole market batch is rejected as failed (ADR-04: a source error is stale/failed, never a silent delisting). Default false.

target.description: Overrides iss.columns.v1.json's default target for this column, for this market only. Not used by any market today.
